talents.e: Cuts mana costs of four damage spells by a tenth.
Adds five percent damage to three lightning and shock spells.
Spell crits add nine percent melee crit chance for ten seconds.
Shortens Shock cooldowns by one second.
Trims half a second off Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst casts.
Boosts fire totems and several fire spells by fifteen percent.
Gives a ten percent chance that your next damage spell is free.
Reduces incoming fire, frost, and nature damage by a tenth.
Boosts Fire Nova damage and cooldown; extends Magma Totem duration.
Cuts cast pushback from damage for three lightning spells by seventy percent.
Earthbind Totem immobilizes nearby enemies for five seconds when cast.
Extends range of several spells and Flame Shock by fifteen yards.
Fire bolt hitting for roughly 150 to 193, stronger on Flame Shocked targets.
Gives lightning spells a ten percent chance to repeat at half damage.
Doubles crit damage bonus for Searing and Magma Totems and elemental spells.
Shortens Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst casts and frees Chain Lightning's cooldown.
Boosts Stoneclaw Totem health and Earthbind Totem radius.
Adds five percent crit chance to all spells and attacks.
Raises Intellect by ten percent.
Increases damage absorbed by two totems and shortens Grounding Totem cooldown.
Converts all of your Intellect into added Attack Power.
Shortens Ghost Wolf cast time and lets it be used indoors.
Lightning Shield orbs deal fifteen percent more damage.
Strengthens Rockbiter, Windfury, Flametongue, and Frostbrand weapon effects.
Cuts Shock and Lightning Shield mana costs by 45 percent.
Adds six percent more chance to dodge attacks.
Raises Stamina by ten percent.
After melee crits, attack speed rises 25 percent for three swings.
Instant melee strike that empowers your next lightning or Earth Shock spell.
Adds parry chance; threat changes based on Rockbiter Weapon being active.
Adds spell damage and healing equal to up to thirty percent of Intellect.
Stormstrike grants mana regeneration and can reset its cooldown on dodges.
Melee hits stack up to five times, cutting next Lightning Bolt cost and cast by twenty percent.
Thirty percent attack speed boost for 25 seconds on a three-minute cooldown.
Shortens Healing Wave cast time by half a second.
Cuts healing mana costs by five percent and adds five percent hit chance.
Keeps half of your mana regeneration active while casting.
Lowers threat from all of your spells by fifteen percent.
Cuts totem mana costs by a quarter, including summon and move spells.
Cuts Reincarnation cooldown and raises maximum health and reincarnation totals.
Healing crits raise target armor by a quarter for 15 seconds.
Seventy percent chance to avoid healing interruption from damage.
Restores mana from hits and healing crits using globes lasting ten minutes.
Raises healing spell critical chance by five percent.
Boosts Mana Spring Totem by a quarter and Healing Stream Totem by half.
Totem pulses 88 mana every few seconds to nearby party members.
Raises the healing done by Healing Wave by twenty-five percent.
Next short Nature spell becomes instant on a three-minute cooldown.
Raises the effectiveness of your healing spells by up to ten percent.
Heals a target and boosts the next Chain Heal on them by 25 percent.
